title: Health Benefits of Herbs
subtitle: Natural wellness for a healthier you
introDescription: Herbs have been used for centuries to support wellness, boost immunity, and promote balance in everyday life. Explore how nature's remedies can help you feel your best.

benefits.title: Supports Immunity
benefits.description: Many herbs like turmeric, ginger, and holy basil help strengthen your body's natural defenses.

benefits.title: Aids Digestion
benefits.description: Herbs such as fennel, peppermint, and cumin soothe the stomach and support healthy digestion.

benefits.title: Promotes Relaxation
benefits.description: Chamomile, lavender, and ashwagandha help calm the mind and reduce everyday stress.

benefits.title: Enhances Energy Levels
benefits.description: Adaptogenic herbs like ginseng and maca naturally boost vitality and mental clarity.
